post.title: CV sites charge you to download your own CV. CVForge doesn't.
post.caption: Fresh grudges: CV builders that bill you at the download button and finance apps that charge a fee to read your own payslip, each replaced by someone annoyed enough to build the free version.

segments.gripe: CV sites charge you to download your own CV.
segments.quote: download a polished CV instantly—without paying expensive CV creator fees.

cues.cap: CV sites let you type for an hour
then charge you to download it.

cues.say: [sarcastic] download a polished C V instantly,

cues.cap: without paying expensive CV creator fees.”
cues.say: without paying expensive C V creator fees.
[quick] So: C V Forge. In your browser.

segments.gripe: Finance apps charge a fee to read your own payslip.
segments.quote: track your pay and tax instead of paying a fee from other finance apps.

cues.cap: instead of paying a fee from other finance apps.”
cues.say: instead of paying a fee from other finance apps.

cues.cap: Enter PayTrack. On your own machine.
cues.say: [quick] Enter PayTrack. On your own machine.

cues.cap: All built out of pure spite.
